name: Nonuniform Compression on Grid Models
definition: A compression strategy that applies different down-sampling scales to volume density ($V_\sigma$) and color features ($V_c$) to reduce storage while preserving rendering quality, based on the insight that density is more critical for model ability than color features.
summary: Nonuniform Compression on Grid Models is a storage optimization technique that asymmetrically down-samples volume density and color features while preserving high-fidelity important voxels to reduce model size without sacrificing rendering quality.
